series.name: Chairside Atlas
series.description: A 30-episode grand tour of everything an optometrist encounters from the moment a patient sits down to the final prescription — exam workflow, history, acuity, pupils, motility, slit lamp, fundus, refraction, and prescribing.

series.name: Retina Revealed
series.description: Everything posterior segment — optic disc, macula, OCT interpretation, diabetic retinopathy, AMD, vascular occlusions, peripheral pathology, and detachments.

series.name: Cornea Confidential
series.description: Cornea, conjunctiva, tear film, and anterior chamber — infectious keratitis, dystrophies, ectasias, cross-linking, endothelial disorders, and anterior chamber grading.

series.name: Glaucoma Guardian
series.description: Open-angle, angle-closure, and secondary glaucomas — IOP, gonioscopy, visual fields, OCT RNFL, progression analysis, and medical, laser, and surgical management.

series.name: Vision Scientists
series.description: The physics and physiology of vision — refraction, optics, accommodation, binocular vision, wavefront, aberrations, contrast sensitivity, color vision, and visual pathways.

series.name: Contact Lens Chronicles
series.description: Soft, rigid, scleral, hybrid, ortho-K, and specialty lenses — topography, sagittal fitting, centration, complications, and managing the unhappy CL patient.

series.name: Pediatric Perspectives
series.tagline: Eye Care from Birth to Teens
series.description: Infant and child eye exams, amblyopia, strabismus screening, refractive development, school vision, myopia control, congenital anomalies, and developmental vision.

series.name: Neuro Navigator
series.tagline: When the Eye Signals the Brain
series.description: Pupillary pathways, cranial nerves, optic neuropathies, visual field defects, transient vision loss, headache workup, papilledema, and when to image.

series.name: Dry Eye Dialogues
series.description: TBUT, osmolarity, meibography, lipid/aqueous/mixed DED, IPL, LipiFlow, scleral lenses for OSD, Demodex, and the chronic dry eye management ladder.

series.name: Refractive Rundown
series.description: LASIK, PRK, SMILE, ICL, RLE, presbyopia corrections, candidacy, topography, wavefront-guided, enhancements, and managing post-op optometry care.

series.name: Emergency Eye
series.description: Chemical burns, open globes, retrobulbar hemorrhage, GCA/AION, endophthalmitis, retinal detachment, acute angle closure, and trauma protocols.

series.name: Practice Pulse
series.description: Patient flow, billing and coding, optical dispensing, staff management, technology ROI, telehealth, patient retention, compliance, and practice growth.

series.name: Pharmacology Focus
series.description: Antibiotics, antivirals, antifungals, anti-inflammatories, IOP-lowering agents, mydriatics, cycloplegics, anesthetics, dry eye drugs, and systemic medications with ocular effects.

series.name: Low Vision Lifeline
series.description: Low vision assessment, magnification, field enhancement, eccentric viewing, assistive technology, driving cessation counseling, and psychosocial support.

series.name: Uveitis Unveiled
series.description: Anterior, intermediate, posterior, and panuveitis — masquerade syndromes, systemic associations, step-up therapy, steroids, immunomodulators, and when to refer.

series.name: Oculoplastics Outlook
series.description: Ptosis, entropion/ectropion, chalazion/hordeolum, lacrimal obstruction, thyroid eye disease, orbital fractures, periocular tumors, and blepharoplasty.

series.name: Strabismus Spotlight
series.description: Esotropia, exotropia, vertical deviations, incomitant strabismus, amblyopia treatment, vergence disorders, convergence insufficiency, and vision therapy principles.

series.name: Imaging Insights
series.description: OCT (macula, RNFL, anterior), fundus photography, FAF, angiography (FA/ICG), autorefraction, topography, biometry, and ultrasound — reading and interpreting images.

series.name: Systemic Eye
series.tagline: Where the Body Meets the Eye
series.description: Diabetes, hypertension, autoimmune disease, thyroid, HIV, tuberculosis, syphilis, sarcoidosis, carotid disease — the eye as a window to systemic health.

series.name: Clinical Calculus
series.description: Complex case reasoning — equivocal discs, borderline fields, progressive myopia, prescribing dilemmas, risk communication, medico-legal awareness, and evidence-based practice.
